objective: Falsify existing generic supplier reconciliation, compare a bounded E-Rate public amendment source case, prioritize a next legally runnable buyer outcome.

opportunities.buyer: Accounting/payables teams procuring manual supplier-statement-to-invoice reconciliation
opportunities.pain: Monthly exception review against books or invoices
opportunities.decisive_experiment: Requires licensed paired real buyer statement and invoices, independently labeled errors and same-input incumbent comparison
opportunities.reason: incumbents already implement matching and exception classification, no independently sourced novel paid outcome

opportunities.buyer: E-Rate service-provider sales and procurement bid team; buyer-posted application request
opportunities.pain: Detect which public Form 470/RFP changes may affect a quote without confusing subsequent award records with bidding changes
opportunities.differentiation: HYPOTHESIS_ONLY: source-verifiable cross-document changed requirement/price schedule classification, not generic alert or scoring
opportunities.decisive_experiment: Retrieve original and amended public documents with allowed access, compare exact text/quantities/deadline changes against independent page metadata, compare same-input source/competitor where available
opportunities.operational_burden: offline standardlib proof zero paid runtime; ongoing source access, OCR/PDF, legal time and buyer support unproven
opportunities.kill: If official page already offers all changed-obligation evidence or direct substitute parity is similar, or actual original+amended source bytes cannot be obtained lawfully, KILL

opportunities.buyer: Community mini-grant program seeking to populate closeout documents from submissions

substitutes.name: Google Apps Script and Microsoft Power Automate
substitutes.evidence: job asks for platform-specific workflow integrations

opportunities.differentiation: HYPOTHESIS_ONLY: private-schema-compatible zero-support export with explicit missing-evidence

opportunities.operational_burden: customer-specific accounts and template mapping; likely onboarding/support, not near-zero One Man

opportunities.buyer: Small and medium organizations posting Excel cleanup jobs
opportunities.pain: Remove duplicate rows, normalize names, missing values and formats
opportunities.decisive_experiment: Would require a distinct labeled high-value transformation already proven unachievable by existing customer tools

opportunities.reason: requested deliverables explicitly basic CLI cleanup, not defensible product

next_action: One bounded E-Rate original-versus-amendment document-content proof with independent changed-condition labeling. If same-case source/competitor parity cannot be demonstrated, close this wedge and try a separately buyer-posted machine-deliverable task.
